Hi Priya / Liam — thanks for the quick turnaround and the questionnaire — I pulled the file and started a pass. A few clarifying items before we schedule the call so the kickoff is productive: 

A. Scope clarifications we need confirmed in writing:
  1) Data classification: is the patient intake data PHI or de-identified at ingest? If PHI, what controls are in place for encryption-in-transit and at-rest?
  2) S3 lifecycle: will audit logs be kept for 7 years? Who owns the retention policy?
  3) On-prem connector: where is the batch job executed (customer data center vs. managed hosting)? We need IP ranges or the VPN endpoint.

B. Immediate evidence requests (short list for kickoff):
  - SOC2 report (link provided by Priya)
  - Network diagram (high-level) — please attach the Drive link or send PDF (network-diagram-stub.pdf is fine for kickoff)
  - Data flow diagram showing where tokens / patient identifiers flow
  - Any contractual constraints (DPA / data residency clauses)

C. Decision criteria we use for scope gating (so the buying team is aware):
  - If PHI is in scope and logs contain identifiers, we will need either Dedicated/Private deployment or a documented encryption key management plan; hosted API may still be acceptable with controls, but requires stricter review.
  - Availability SLA expectations: if Verdant requires <100ms P95 for certain endpoints, we will map to Dedicated capacity estimates.

D. Proposed timeline (assuming questionnaire + network diagram by EOD tomorrow):
  - Day 0: confirm scope + evidence receipt
  - Day 1–4: security team review + written clarifying questions
  - Day 5–10: remedial/architectural follow-ups (if needed)
  - Day 10–14: final scope sign-off and handoff to procurement for contract terms

Please confirm the three scope points (A.1–A.3) and share the network diagram PDF and any retention policy language. If that looks good, David / I will propose two time slots for a 45-min kickoff (Wed 7/8 10:00–10:45 or Thu 7/9 14:00–14:45 PT).

Best,
Marissa
